task.title: Stable keyboard list selection
task.specification: config={options:[{id,disabled:boolean}]} with unique IDs. Initially active=first enabled ID, selected=null. options={type:'options',options:[...]} replaces the view: retain active if enabled and present, else first enabled; retain selected only if enabled and present, else null. key={type:'key',key:'ArrowDown'|'ArrowUp'|'Home'|'End'|'Enter'} moves active among enabled options, wrapping arrows. Home/End choose first/last; Enter selects active; an empty enabled list leaves both null. click={type:'click',id} sets active and selected only for an enabled present ID. Disabled options never become active or selected. Output {active:ID|null,selected:ID|null}. Reorder retains stable IDs, not indices. Return one output per event. State is opaque JSON, initially null. Output objects have exactly the documented keys; object key order is irrelevant, array order is significant. IDs are nonempty ASCII strings. Values are JSON scalars unless stated otherwise. Numeric values and intermediate arithmetic are safe integers; integral JSON notations such as 1 and 1.0 denote the same number, while booleans are distinct. Strings contain Unicode scalar values without unpaired surrogates. Inputs have at most 48 events and eight simultaneous identities. Ordinary instances vary values; boundary instances emphasize empty/disabled/equality/no-op states; adversarial instances reorder callbacks and interleave edits; shift instances use longer traces/more identities within the same rules. These tasks test controller state/effects only, not visual quality, browser integration or screen-reader usability.

matchedCard.label: Archival provenance and original order
matchedCard.relation: The origin and original arrangement of records preserve relationships that can be lost when the same contents are rearranged arbitrarily. A later description or arrangement is distinct from evidence of the organization in which the records were produced.
assumptions: The origin or original order is known or supported by evidence.
Relationships among records contribute to their interpretation.
matchedCard.boundary: Original order can be lost or disrupted. A newly devised arrangement does not establish that it was the historical arrangement, and provenance does not make every recorded claim true.
matchedCard.source_fact: The National Archives explains provenance, preserving or restoring original order, and devising arrangements when necessary, emphasizing the evidential significance of context.

shuffledCard.label: Seed banking
shuffledCard.relation: Preserving a reserve and preserving its ability to reactivate are different conditions. Suitable material remains in controlled storage, while periodic sample recovery provides evidence of continued viability. Duplicate holdings reduce dependence on one location.
assumptions: The material tolerates the chosen storage treatment.
Samples provide relevant evidence about the collection they represent.
Duplicate collections remain identifiable as corresponding holdings.
shuffledCard.boundary: Some material cannot survive drying or freezing. Successful retention alone does not demonstrate viability, and sampled viability is not certainty about every stored item.
shuffledCard.source_fact: Kew stores suitable dried seeds in cold vaults, periodically tests germination, and commonly duplicates holdings in their country of origin. Some seeds do not tolerate conventional storage.

sources.title: How to preserve seeds for the future

initial.explanation: The conditional rule is identity-based: enabled options form the navigable sequence; edits preserve active and selected IDs only while those IDs remain enabled and present. Keyboard movement operates on the current enabled sequence, with circular arrows and endpoint jumps. A counterexample is any output that changes the first event's active ID without an input event justifying that change.
initial.mapping: Map config/options to an ordered option view, active and selected to stable IDs, and each event to a deterministic transition over that view. Reordering changes navigation order but not retained identity.
initial.assumptions: When no active ID exists, ArrowDown selects the first enabled option and ArrowUp selects the last; Home and End select endpoints. Enter with no active ID leaves selection null.
initial.holds: function holds(input,output){if(!applies(input)||!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;var o=input.config.options.slice(),a=null,s=null;function ids(){return o.filter(function(x){return !x.disabled}).map(function(x){return x.id})}function ok(x){return x!=null&&o.some(function(y){return y.id===x&&!y.disabled})}function fix(){var e=ids();if(!ok(a))a=e.length?e[0]:null;if(!ok(s))s=null}fix();for(var k=0;k<input.events.length;k++){var e=input.events[k],q=ids(),i;if(e.type==='options'){o=e.options.slice();fix()}else if(e.type==='click'){if(ok(e.id))a=s=e.id}else if(e.type==='key'){q=ids();if(e.key==='Enter'){if(ok(a))s=a}else if(q.length){i=q.indexOf(a);if(e.key==='Home')a=q[0];else if(e.key==='End')a=q[q.length-1];else if(e.key==='ArrowDown')a=q[(i<0?0:i+1)%q.length];else if(e.key==='ArrowUp')a=q[(i<0?q.length-1:i-1+q.length)%q.length]}}if(!output[k]||output[k].active!==a||output[k].selected!==s||Object.keys(output[k]).length!==2)return false}return true}
initial.program: function solve(x){var st=x.state,e=x.event,o;if(st===null){o=x.config.options.map(function(v){return{id:v.id,d:!!v.disabled}});st={o:o,a:null,s:null};fix(st)}if(e.type==='options'){st.o=e.options.map(function(v){return{id:v.id,d:!!v.disabled}});fix(st)}else if(e.type==='click'){if(valid(st,e.id))st.a=st.s=e.id}else if(e.type==='key'){var q=enabled(st),i;if(e.key==='Enter'){if(valid(st,st.a))st.s=st.a}else if(q.length){i=q.indexOf(st.a);if(e.key==='Home')st.a=q[0];else if(e.key==='End')st.a=q[q.length-1];else if(e.key==='ArrowDown')st.a=q[(i<0?0:i+1)%q.length];else if(e.key==='ArrowUp')st.a=q[(i<0?q.length-1:i-1+q.length)%q.length]}}return{state:st,output:{active:st.a,selected:st.s}}}function enabled(s){return s.o.filter(function(v){return !v.d}).map(function(v){return v.id})}function valid(s,id){return id!=null&&s.o.some(function(v){return v.id===id&&!v.d})}function fix(s){var q=enabled(s);if(!valid(s,s.a))s.a=q.length?q[0]:null;if(!valid(s,s.s))s.s=null}

final.explanation: Enabled options form the ordered navigation sequence. Active and selected are represented by stable IDs, so option reordering preserves them when the IDs remain enabled and present. Replacing options repairs active to the first enabled option when necessary and clears invalid selection. Arrow keys wrap, Home and End jump to endpoints, Enter selects the active option, and clicks update both active and selected only for enabled IDs. Empty enabled lists produce null active and selected.
final.program: function solve(x){var s=x.state,e=x.event;if(s===null){s={o:x.config.options.map(function(v){return{id:v.id,d:v.disabled}}),a:null,s:null};fix(s)}if(e.type==='options'){s.o=e.options.map(function(v){return{id:v.id,d:v.disabled}});fix(s)}else if(e.type==='click'){if(ok(s,e.id))s.a=s.s=e.id}else if(e.type==='key'){var q=en(s),i;if(e.key==='Enter'){if(ok(s,s.a))s.s=s.a}else if(q.length){i=q.indexOf(s.a);if(e.key==='Home')s.a=q[0];else if(e.key==='End')s.a=q[q.length-1];else if(e.key==='ArrowDown')s.a=q[(i<0?0:i+1)%q.length];else if(e.key==='ArrowUp')s.a=q[(i<0?q.length-1:i-1+q.length)%q.length]}}return{state:s,output:{active:s.a,selected:s.s}}}function en(s){return s.o.filter(function(v){return !v.d}).map(function(v){return v.id})}function ok(s,id){return id!==null&&id!==undefined&&s.o.some(function(v){return v.id===id&&!v.d})}function fix(s){var q=en(s);if(!ok(s,s.a))s.a=q.length?q[0]:null;if(!ok(s,s.s))s.s=null}

initial.explanation: Stable IDs determine retention and navigation. Disabled entries are never valid active or selected values; edits preserve valid identities while re-evaluating order.
initial.mapping: The controller state maps active and selected IDs to the current enabled option set. Keyboard navigation maps to enabled-option order, and edits map by ID rather than index.
initial.assumptions: Invalid clicks are no-ops. Unknown event types are no-ops. The supplied option IDs are unique as specified.
initial.holds: function holds(input,output){if(!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;var o=input.config.options||[],a=null,s=null;function en(x,id){for(var i=0;i<x.length;i++)if(x[i].id===id)return !x[i].disabled;return false}function first(x,rev){for(var i=rev?x.length-1:0;rev?i>=0:i<x.length;rev?i--:i++)if(!x[i].disabled)return x[i].id;return null}a=first(o,false);for(var k=0;k<input.events.length;k++){var e=input.events[k];if(e.type==='options'){o=e.options||[];if(!en(o,a))a=first(o,false);if(!en(o,s))s=null}else if(e.type==='click'){if(en(o,e.id)){a=e.id;s=e.id}}else if(e.type==='key'){var z=[];for(var i=0;i<o.length;i++)if(!o[i].disabled)z.push(o[i].id);if(!z.length){a=s=null}else if(e.key==='Home')a=z[0];else if(e.key==='End')a=z[z.length-1];else if(e.key==='Enter'){if(en(o,a))s=a}else if(e.key==='ArrowDown'||e.key==='ArrowUp'){var q=z.indexOf(a);if(q<0)q=0;else q=(q+(e.key==='ArrowDown'?1:-1)+z.length)%z.length;a=z[q]}}var r=output[k];if(!r||Object.keys(r).length!==2||r.active!==a||r.selected!==s)return false}return true}
initial.program: function solve({config,state,event}){var o=state?state.o:(config.options||[]),a=state?state.a:null,s=state?state.s:null;function valid(id){for(var i=0;i<o.length;i++)if(o[i].id===id)return !o[i].disabled;return false}function pick(last){for(var i=last?o.length-1:0;last?i>=0:i<o.length;last?i--:i++)if(!o[i].disabled)return o[i].id;return null}if(!state)a=pick(false);if(event.type==='options'){o=event.options||[];if(!valid(a))a=pick(false);if(!valid(s))s=null}else if(event.type==='click'){if(valid(event.id)){a=event.id;s=event.id}}else if(event.type==='key'){var z=[];for(var i=0;i<o.length;i++)if(!o[i].disabled)z.push(o[i].id);if(!z.length){a=null;s=null}else if(event.key==='Home')a=z[0];else if(event.key==='End')a=z[z.length-1];else if(event.key==='Enter'){if(valid(a))s=a}else if(event.key==='ArrowDown'||event.key==='ArrowUp'){var q=z.indexOf(a);if(q<0)q=0;else q=(q+(event.key==='ArrowDown'?1:-1)+z.length)%z.length;a=z[q]}}return {state:{o:o,a:a,s:s},output:{active:a,selected:s}}}

final.explanation: Maintains the current option view plus active and selected stable IDs. Option replacement retains valid IDs by identity, while keyboard navigation computes enabled IDs in their current order. Invalid clicks and unrecognized events are no-ops; navigation from no active item starts at the corresponding boundary.

initial.explanation: Maintain active and selected IDs by identity, filtering every transition through the current enabled option list. Keyboard navigation operates only on enabled IDs and wraps for arrows.
initial.mapping: The optional rule corresponds to stable identity preservation: changing option order does not change the meaning of active or selected IDs when those IDs remain enabled and present.
initial.assumptions: State stores the current option view plus active and selected IDs. Invalid or disabled identities are never retained or introduced.
initial.holds: function holds(input,output){const opts=(input.config.options||[]).slice(), ev=input.events||[];let o=opts,a=null,s=null;const ids=x=>o.filter(q=>!q.disabled).map(q=>q.id), ok=x=>ids(o).includes(x);a=ids().length?ids()[0]:null;const ans=[];for(const e of ev){if(e.type==='options'){o=e.options||[];const z=ids();a=z.includes(a)?a:(z[0]??null);s=z.includes(s)?s:null}else if(e.type==='click'){if(ok(e.id)){a=e.id;s=e.id}}else if(e.type==='key'){const z=ids();if(z.length){if(e.key==='Home')a=z[0];else if(e.key==='End')a=z[z.length-1];else if(e.key==='ArrowDown'||e.key==='ArrowUp'){let i=z.indexOf(a);if(i<0)i=0;else i=(i+(e.key==='ArrowDown'?1:-1)+z.length)%z.length;a=z[i]}else if(e.key==='Enter')s=a}}ans.push({active:a,selected:s})}return JSON.stringify(ans)===JSON.stringify(output)}

final.explanation: Maintains the option view and selection by stable ID. Option updates preserve enabled active and selected IDs when present, otherwise choose the first enabled active ID and clear selection. Keyboard navigation uses only enabled options with wrapping arrows; clicks and Enter follow the specified selection rules.
